summary: More community.vmware deprecations for 7.0.0: vmware_cluster_info, content deploy and library modules, vmware_guest_powerstate, vmware_host, vmware_maintenancemode, the vmware_host_inventory and vmware_vm_inventory plugins, and mac_learning in vmware_dvs_portgroup.
questions: Where does mac_learning go in vmware_dvs_portgroup now?

answer_card.title: community.vmware deprecations (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed in community.vmware 7.0.0:

- Modules: `vmware_cluster_info`, `vmware_content_deploy_ovf_template`, `vmware_content_deploy_template`, `vmware_content_library_manager`, `vmware_guest_powerstate`, `vmware_host`, `vmware_maintenancemode`.
- Inventory plugins: `vmware_host_inventory`, `vmware_vm_inventory`.
- `vmware_rest_client.get_folder_by_name`.

`vmware_dvs_portgroup`: `mac_learning` deprecated in favor of `network_policy.mac_learning`.
